verdict.rationale: Canva documents an official command-line tool, and a probe confirms it in the Apps quickstart. Its stated scope is creating and managing Canva apps, not operating designs, assets or exports from the terminal, and no AI-native or agent-oriented use of it is evidenced. missing for 10: CLI coverage of core Canva operations (designs, exports, assets), documented AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, command reference depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Leverage a command line tool designed for creating and managing Canva apps.
